text: A股房地产板块大幅高开，我爱我家、特发服务、世联行、金融街、香江控股、深物业A、中交发展等多股一字涨停，消息上，中国人民银行、金融监管总局联合印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理 推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，个人住房贷款最长期限延长至40年。
text_en: A-share real estate sector opened sharply higher, with multiple stocks including 5i5j, Tefa Service, WorldUnion, Financial Street, Xiangjiang Holding, Shenzhen Properties A and CCCC Development hitting the daily limit up. News: PBOC and NFRA jointly issued the "Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Construction of a New Real Estate Development Model", extending the maximum term for individual housing loans to 40 years.
